property_summary: After calling cancelProposal(oldProposalID, newProposalID), proposalCount is never less than the original count of proposals before the call.
After any sequence of calls ending with cancelProposal(uint256,uint256), the USDV address must be the original non-zero address passed to init.
After cancelProposal, USDV address must remain unchanged (equal to original value set in init).
After cancelProposal, USDV must equal the address set in init (0xUSDV).
After cancelProposal, the stored USDV address should remain the same as the one set during init.
After calling cancelProposal, the USDV address must equal the address originally set during init.
After cancelProposal, USDV address equals the address set in init
After any call to cancelProposal, the VAULT state variable remains unchanged (its initial value after init).
After cancelProposal, the mapPID_address at the old proposal ID is zero.
After cancelProposal, the mapPID_address at the old proposal ID is unchanged (remains the proposed address) if the old proposal type is 'ADDRESS'.
After cancelProposal(oldProposalID, newProposalID), the votes of oldProposalID remain unchanged (are not zeroed).
After cancelProposal(oldProposalID, newProposalID), the votes of newProposalID are still greater than zero if they were nonzero before the call.
After cancelProposal(old, new), the sum of votes for old and new proposal IDs is preserved (the votes are just moved from old to new).
After cancelProposal(oldProposalID, newProposalID), the total number of proposals (proposalCount) is unchanged.
After cancelProposal(old, new), the votes of newProposalID are unchanged from before the call if the votes of oldProposalID were originally nonzero.
After any call to cancelProposal, the timeStart of the canceled proposal must equal block.timestamp (or at least be nonzero), not zero.
After cancelProposal, the timeStart of the old proposal must be greater than or equal to the timeStart set in _finalise (which should be block.timestamp), not zero.
After cancelProposal, mapPID_timeStart of the old proposal must preserve the value set in _finalise, which is block.timestamp, not zero.
After cancelProposal, the mapPID_timeStart of the old proposal must be greater than or equal to the earliest possible block.timestamp at contract creation, i.e., non-zero.

After cancelProposal (which requires the old proposal to be in finalising state), the timeStart of the old proposal must be at least as large as the block.timestamp at the moment it was put into finalising state (i.e., cannot be reduced to zero).
After cancelProposal, mapPID_timeStart[oldProposalID] is never reset to zero when mapPID_finalising[oldProposalID] is true.

After cancelProposal, if mapPID_finalising[oldProposalID] becomes true again (due to re-finalisation), then mapPID_timeStart[oldProposalID] must be greater than or equal to the timestamp of the original finalisation, which the bug breaks by setting it earlier.
After cancelProposal, the old proposal's finalising flag is always false when its timeStart is non-zero.
After cancelProposal, mapPID_finalising[oldProposalID] is always false if mapPID_timeStart[oldProposalID] was set before the cancel.
After cancelProposal, the timestamp when the old proposal was finalised must be earlier than the timestamp when it was cancelled.
